annotation.title_clean: 关于优化实施设备更新贷款财政贴息政策的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Optimizing the Implementation of the Fiscal Interest Subsidy Policy for Equipment Renewal Loans
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 财政部; 国家发展改革委; 中国人民银行; 金融监管总局
annotation.summary_en: Chinese ministerial notice (Cai Jin [2026] No. 2) optimizing the central fiscal interest subsidy for equipment renewal loans: 1.5-point subsidy for up to two years, expanded sectors including artificial intelligence and elder care, 26 banks, streamlined disbursement and settlement, and supervision. Effective 1 January 2026.
key_provisions_or_claims: Central government subsidizes 1.5 percentage points of equipment renewal loan principal for up to 2 years, through 31 Dec 2026 (extendable).
Expands supported sectors to include AI, elder care, aviation equipment, electronics, safety production and others.
Pre-allocation plus settlement disbursement, with joint provincial review within 5 working days.
Joint spot checks, clawback of subsidies and bank liability for violations.
